chapter_title: Concerning the Four Great Days that have come fort

4.original: [The third day is the Pillar of Glory, the great porter that is greater than]
4.content: The third day is the Pillar of Glory, the great porter that is greater than

spiritual_reading:
The first state of full illumination is the Divine Itself as the source of truth, the first principle abiding in the living order of heaven. The complete cycle of this illumination is the full organization of primary divine operations in that order. These first effluxes, brought forth to make the Divine greatness visible in reception, were established in the whole expanse of the ultimate plane in complete arrangement, by discrete degrees set in every quarter of the domain before the Divine presence.

The second state of illumination is the mediating Divine operation that communicates between the highest and what is beneath, abiding within the doctrinal and knowing vessels of light in the outer degree. Its complete cycle is the full complement of pure receptive affections of truth that it called forth within its own greatness.

The third state of illumination is the sustaining divine stability that stands as the universal boundary and guardian, surpassing all lesser safeguards, holding together what is higher and what is lower and bearing the equilibrium of the whole. Its complete cycle is the sufficient complement of operative powers that belong to the good that first engages evil, together with the sufficient complement of operative powers that belong to the living Divine action which rescues and orders; these uphold the full burden of the created arrangement. With them are the directed influx and the responsive compliance that complete the fullness of this operation, making one entire series of light in that state.

The fourth state of illumination is the Divine truth made resplendent within the gathered community of reception. Its complete cycle is the full organization of distinct forms of wisdom by which that reception is enlightened and ordered.

As there are complete states of illumination, so there are complete states of obscuration.

The first state of obscuration is the realm of active falsity. Within it is a full cycle of darkened perceptions, which are its measured stages of blindness. This fullness is constituted by a sufficient series of fundamental falsities that pour out from the perverted faculties of sensation and discernment; and from these, further disorderings arise within the same series of falsities and their extensions. In them dwell ruling persuasions that animate those falsities and make them living shadows. This is the full set of dark stages and their animating falsities in the first obscuration.

The second state of obscuration is the formative principle of the natural level when separated from heaven, which fashions delusive appearances and, with them, the whole dominion that rules in falsity. It composes this dominion through perverted sensory forms and their paired impulses in every organized domain, by which falsity and evil conjoin and replicate; and with these it instills self-love and the craving that dwell in both kinds of corrupted affection, inflaming them inwardly toward mutual binding. This is the full set of animating forces in the second obscuration.

This same formative principle, which is the intention of spiritual death, gave the ruling falsity of that realm and its subordinate persuasions force for conflict against heaven. Yet that ruling falsity was restrained: it was ensnared through the good that first engages evil, taken by means of contending persuasions, removed from the state of spiritual death, and compelled into fixed positions of service in the universal order. It was set through the whole arrangement in sufficient divisions, in higher degrees as well as in lower, together with the opposing inclinations that act as generative forces in that realm, namely the ardor of self-love and the craving that proceeds from it.

This is the second obscuration as it is produced from the first. It too was brought under restraint through the good that first engages evil. It was drawn up by the living Divine action, and fixed into this mixed order in higher and lower degrees, so that its upper aspect acts through the distorted sensory forms that dominate the corrupted masculine principle, and its lower aspect through those that dominate the corrupted feminine principle; the sense here is partly unclear, but it indicates a division of the perverted faculties into higher and lower functions within the composite order.

The third state of obscuration is the full series of corporeal loves in their organized domains, in sufficient forms of both kinds, generated from the persuasions that were set above. These have fallen into the lowest degree, becoming manifest in what is devoid of living truth and in what is merely natural truth, together with self-love and the craving that dwell within such loves and drive them inwardly to conjoin.

The formative intention of spiritual death is the common origin of them all; therefore within those domains it is called the obscuration itself. The organized corporeal loves in both kinds, together with self-love and craving, make up the full cycle of stages in that third obscuration. This third obscuration, existing in corporeal domains, was begotten from the second; and the living Divine action held it fixed throughout the universal order in higher and lower degrees, so that even what is lowest might be compelled into boundaries and uses within a mixed arrangement.

The fourth state of obscuration is the reigning principle of evil as if it were law, the dark spirit that speaks and operates through a full set of falsified doctrines and divided persuasions. These are the exposures of evil without any covering of truth, the complete arrangement of delusive generalities produced by the formative natural principle. These are its seats of judgment, by which it is openly expressed as it forms and displays itself in the inherited selfhood.

The measured stages of this fourth obscuration—namely of the inherited selfhood ruling within the divided persuasions—are the full set of evil loves and falsities that proceed from that selfhood. By them the mind is made to distinguish good from evil, and truth from falsity, not by life but by deadened discrimination, establishing for itself a rhythm of spiritual death.

This is the fourth obscuration, and these obscurations come forth from one another. As the states of illumination are ordered in succession and make their pattern manifest by degrees, so also these states of obscuration arise in sequence, each brought forth from what preceded it and each making the next possible within the same perverted progression.

fills.notes: The spiritual sense requires “first principle abiding…”. In the substrate register this is expressed as the Father as the first principle “that is” within the aeons, not as a personal title. The surviving letters fir[st … … m]idst also constrain to “first … a … midst”.

fills.fill: The third day is the Pillar of Glory, the great porter that is greater than
fills.notes: Given already in the core and matches the correspondential function: the universal boundary and support surpassing lesser safeguards.

What the Pillar supports must be the totality in discrete degrees: “those above and those below”. “Things” fits the impersonal cosmological register and the structural spiritual sense (“holding together what is higher and what is lower”).

This is likely a remaining layer-2 dialogue seam. But some speech-intro is demanded before the colon. Keeping it minimal and non-devotional; it simply introduces the structural axiom about nights corresponding to days.

The twelve must be: 5 elements + 5 ‘spirits’ + 2 completing factors (as elsewhere: fire and lust). Here the text already later counts “the five spirits…”. So after the five elements, a second pentad is required: in Manichaean-darkness taxonomy this is “smoke” (a dark factor distinct from the elements) as a set of five. It matches the spiritual sense: “further disorderings arise within the same series… and their extensions.”
The spiritual sense calls for “further disorderings arise within the same series…”. The substrate way of saying this is that these dark products “mix” and “bind” within the elements and their organs.
Completes the paired structure: “its five elements and its five sense organs”. This is demanded by the earlier clause “poured forth from its five sense organs.”
The five spirits are said to ‘dwell’ in the elements; “within them” makes the indwelling explicit in the impersonal cosmological register.
Matter as the sculptress belongs to and works from the dark realm; “of the darknesses” fits the next clause about sculpting the rulers in the “worlds of darkness.”

What Matter ‘sculpted’ in the oldest cosmological layer is the corporeal formations by which the rulers act. “Bodies” matches the spiritual sense (“delusive appearances” given form) without later moralizing.

The spiritual sense: the ruling falsity is “removed… and compelled into fixed positions… in higher and lower degrees.” The narrative idiom is “taken… and brought up”. “To the height” supplies the upward transition before the next sentence “He was brought up…”.
After “through the powers …” the substrate expects the restraint motif: seized by contending powers and bound. This matches the spiritual sense “restrained… taken by means of contending persuasions.”
Restores “set to stand above and below”, matching the Pillar-like fixing into positions of service and the spiritual sense “compelled into fixed positions… in higher and lower degrees.”
The clause needs the fixing action in the composite order: “set in this composite universe and set her… above and below.” This aligns with the spiritual sense “fixed into this mixed order”.

Completes the bipartite correspondential division demanded by the spiritual sense: upper aspect acting through perverted sensory forms; lower likewise. The surviving text already gives the male side explicitly next.
The line requires the total “five male and five female” as a single cosmological set; restoring “ten worlds of flesh” makes the counting explicit in the oldest-layer cataloguing style.
The sentence needs a verb of constitution: these items “make up” the twelve hours, matching the spiritual sense “make up the full cycle of stages”.
“twelve hours of … … night” points to naming the very night being described; “this third” is the structurally demanded identifier.

The spiritual sense: the Living Spirit “held it fixed throughout the universal order… in higher and lower degrees.” So the crucifixion motif here functions as fixing; “in the universe and set…” expresses that in the substrate register.
Balances “in heaven …” with the required lower degree, matching the persistent above-below schema.
“the … of the old man” in this register is his operative forces proceeding from selfhood; “powers” matches the preceding talk of spirits and ruling-power without importing later moral exhortation.
The syntax needs a relative clause introducing what these spirits do; spiritually, they establish a dead discrimination. “Proceed and” prepares for “differentiate…”.
The spiritual sense explicitly: “establishing for itself a rhythm of spiritual death.” So the phrase before “death” should signal that measured alternation.
The closing recapitulates the series: “This is the fourth night, and these are the nights that have come forth…” This matches the spiritual translation’s summary about successive arising.
Fits “One has … just like the days of light…”. The verb required is generation in sequence; “been begotten” keeps the impersonal cosmological tone.
Completes “So also … they did arise out of one another.” “In turn” captures ordered succession by degrees, as in the spiritual sense.

assessment: Most lacunae are small and restore securely from immediate syntax. The substantial gaps occur in ¶8–¶11 and ¶15, where counting-logic (twelve by composition) and the chapter’s governing correspondence (above-below fixing; four days mirrored by four nights) constrain the restorations. A few places remain only moderately constrained because the Coptic Vorlage could have used several equivalent verbs for restraint and fixing; I selected the forms that best match the oldest-layer impersonal cosmological register and the spiritual progression described.
